mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(email, pw, nickname, birthday, gender, type) VALUES (#{email}, #{pw}, #{nickname}, #{birthday}, #{gender}, #{type});
mapper.select: SELECT id, email, pw, nickname, birthday, gender, type FROM user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT u.email, u.nickname, u.birthday, u.gender, i.img_url FROM user u LEFT JOIN image i ON u.id = i.owner_id AND i.type = 'USER' AND i.rep_img_yn = 'Y' WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
